title: Hazel and the Veil
author: Cyrus Sandoval
blurb: Emrys Galloway, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
